title: Chapter5
description: Finnish vocabulary: home, apartments, household items, recycling and verbs

questions.question: Topic / Subject
questions.explanation: 'Aihe' means topic or subject; its genitive is 'aiheen'.
questions.exampletranslate: This is an interesting topic.

questions.question: Downstairs / Lower floor
questions.explanation: 'Alakerta' means downstairs or the lower floor; its genitive is 'alakerran'.
questions.exampletranslate: The kitchen is downstairs.

questions.question: Alko (state liquor store)
questions.explanation: 'Alko' is the Finnish state-owned alcohol store.
questions.exampletranslate: Wine is bought from Alko.

questions.question: To give
questions.explanation: 'Antaa' (type 1 verb) means to give; 'annan' is 'I give'.
questions.exampletranslate: I give you the key.

questions.question: Pharmacy
questions.exampletranslate: I buy the medicine from the pharmacy.

questions.question: Dish / Container
questions.exampletranslate: I wash the dishes in the evening.

questions.question: Apartment / Dwelling
questions.explanation: 'Asunto' means apartment or dwelling; its genitive is 'asunnon'.
questions.exampletranslate: I am looking for a new apartment.

questions.question: To help
questions.explanation: 'Auttaa' (type 1 verb) means to help; 'autan' is 'I help' (takes a partitive object).
questions.exampletranslate: I help you with the move.

questions.question: Key
questions.exampletranslate: Where is the apartment key?

questions.question: Bar
questions.exampletranslate: We meet at the bar in the evening.

questions.question: Bio waste
questions.explanation: 'Biojäte' means bio waste; its genitive is 'biojätteen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The banana peel goes in the bio waste.

questions.question: Different
questions.exampletranslate: This apartment is different.

questions.question: Entrance hall / Hallway
questions.explanation: 'Eteinen' means entrance hall or hallway; its genitive is 'eteisen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The shoes are in the hallway.

questions.question: Jeans
questions.explanation: 'Farkut' means jeans (a plural word); its genitive is 'farkkujen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy new jeans.

questions.question: Hair
questions.explanation: 'Hiukset' means hair (a plural word); its genitive is 'hiusten'.
questions.exampletranslate: She has long hair.

questions.question: Room
questions.exampletranslate: The apartment has three rooms.

questions.question: Furniture
questions.exampletranslate: I buy new furniture.

questions.question: Boring / Unpleasant / Dull
questions.explanation: 'Ikävä' means boring, dull or unpleasant (it can also mean missing someone).
questions.exampletranslate: This is an unpleasant matter.

questions.question: Sometimes
questions.exampletranslate: Sometimes I go swimming.

questions.question: Train
questions.exampletranslate: I travel to Helsinki by train.

questions.question: Train station
questions.exampletranslate: The train station is in the centre.

questions.question: Lake
questions.exampletranslate: I swim in the lake in summer.

questions.question: Waste / Trash
questions.exampletranslate: I sort the waste.

questions.question: Two-room apartment
questions.explanation: 'Kaksio' means a two-room apartment (one room plus kitchen).
questions.exampletranslate: I live in a small two-room apartment.

questions.question: Saucepan / Pot
questions.exampletranslate: I boil water in the pot.

questions.question: Far away
questions.exampletranslate: The shop is far from home.

questions.question: Beautiful
questions.exampletranslate: This is a beautiful home.

questions.question: City district / Part of the city
questions.explanation: 'Kaupunginosa' means a city district or part of the city.
questions.exampletranslate: I live in a quiet part of the city.

questions.question: Kitchenette
questions.explanation: 'Keittokomero' means a kitchenette (a small kitchen alcove).
questions.exampletranslate: The studio has a small kitchenette.

questions.question: Cellar / Basement
questions.exampletranslate: The bicycle is in the basement.

questions.question: Shoe
questions.exampletranslate: I take off my shoes in the hallway.

questions.question: Cell (e.g. honeycomb)
questions.explanation: 'Kenno' means a cell, such as a honeycomb or battery cell.
questions.exampletranslate: The eggs are in the carton (cell tray).

questions.question: Floor / Storey
questions.explanation: 'Kerros' means floor or storey; its genitive is 'kerroksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I live on the third floor.

questions.question: Centre / Downtown
questions.exampletranslate: There are shops in the centre.

questions.question: To last / take (time)
questions.explanation: 'Kestää' (type 1 verb) means to last or take time; 'kestän' is 'I last/endure'.
questions.exampletranslate: The trip takes two hours.

questions.question: To recycle
questions.explanation: 'Kierrättää' (type 1 verb) means to recycle; 'kierrätän' is 'I recycle'.
questions.exampletranslate: I recycle cardboard and paper.

questions.question: Recycling
questions.exampletranslate: Recycling is important.

questions.question: Envelope
questions.explanation: 'Kirjekuori' means envelope, from 'kirje' (letter) and 'kuori' (cover); its genitive is 'kirjekuoren'.
questions.exampletranslate: I put the letter in the envelope.

questions.question: Three-room apartment
questions.explanation: 'Kolmio' means a three-room apartment (two rooms plus kitchen).
questions.exampletranslate: The family lives in a three-room apartment.

questions.question: To fix / repair
questions.explanation: 'Korjata' (type 4 verb) means to fix or repair; 'korjaan' is 'I fix'.
questions.exampletranslate: I fix the broken chair.

questions.question: Dry
questions.exampletranslate: The laundry is already dry.

questions.question: Flower
questions.exampletranslate: I buy flowers for the table.

questions.question: Shell / Peel / Cover
questions.explanation: 'Kuori' means shell, peel or cover; its genitive is 'kuoren'.
questions.exampletranslate: I peel off the apple's skin.

questions.question: Cup
questions.exampletranslate: I drink a cup of coffee.

questions.question: To invite
questions.explanation: 'Kutsua' (type 1 verb) means to invite; 'kutsun' is 'I invite'.
questions.exampletranslate: I invite friends over.

questions.question: Hot
questions.exampletranslate: The coffee is too hot.

questions.question: To listen
questions.explanation: 'Kuunnella' (type 3 verb) means to listen; 'kuuntelen' is 'I listen' (takes a partitive object).
questions.exampletranslate: I listen to the radio.

questions.question: Bathroom
questions.exampletranslate: The shower is in the bathroom.

questions.question: Floor (surface)
questions.explanation: 'Lattia' means floor (the surface you walk on).
questions.exampletranslate: I sweep the floor.

questions.question: Bag / Case
questions.explanation: 'Laukku' means bag or case; its genitive is 'laukun'.
questions.exampletranslate: The keys are in the bag.

questions.question: Too (excessively)
questions.exampletranslate: The apartment is too small.

questions.question: Holiday / Vacation
questions.exampletranslate: In summer there is a long holiday.

questions.question: Spoon
questions.exampletranslate: I eat the soup with a spoon.

questions.question: Short
questions.exampletranslate: This is a short trip.

questions.question: To send
questions.explanation: 'Lähettää' (type 1 verb) means to send; 'lähetän' is 'I send'.
questions.exampletranslate: I send you a letter.

questions.question: Medicine
questions.exampletranslate: I take medicine for a headache.

questions.question: Advertisement
questions.exampletranslate: I saw a good advertisement.

questions.question: Bedroom
questions.explanation: 'Makuuhuone' means bedroom, from 'maata' (to lie) and 'huone'; its genitive is 'makuuhuoneen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The bed is in the bedroom.

questions.question: Trip / Journey
questions.exampletranslate: The journey takes a long time.

questions.question: Forest
questions.exampletranslate: I walk in the forest.

questions.question: To sell
questions.explanation: 'Myydä' (type 2 verb) means to sell; 'myyn' is 'I sell'.
questions.exampletranslate: I sell the old car.

questions.question: Late / Delayed
questions.explanation: 'Myöhässä' means late or delayed (running behind schedule).
questions.exampletranslate: The train is late.

questions.question: Square meter
questions.exampletranslate: The apartment is 50 square meters.

questions.question: To be visible / show
questions.explanation: 'Näkyä' (type 1 verb) means to be visible or to show; 'näyn' is 'I am visible'.
questions.exampletranslate: The lake is visible from the window.

questions.question: Living room
questions.explanation: 'Olohuone' means living room; its genitive is 'olohuoneen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The sofa is in the living room.

questions.question: Detached house
questions.exampletranslate: I dream of a detached house.

questions.question: Cardboard
questions.exampletranslate: I recycle the cardboard.

questions.question: Place
questions.exampletranslate: This is a good place.

questions.question: Services
questions.exampletranslate: There are good services nearby.

questions.question: Paper
questions.exampletranslate: I write on paper.

questions.question: Balcony
questions.exampletranslate: I drink coffee on the balcony.

questions.question: Washing machine
questions.explanation: 'Pesukone' means washing machine; its genitive is 'pesukoneen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The washing machine is in the bathroom.

questions.question: Yard
questions.exampletranslate: The children play in the yard.

questions.question: Bottle
questions.exampletranslate: The water is in the bottle.

questions.question: Half
questions.exampletranslate: I take half of the cake.

questions.question: Jar / Can
questions.explanation: 'Purkki' means jar or can; its genitive is 'purkin'.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a jar of jam.

questions.question: (Bus) stop
questions.explanation: 'Pysäkki' means a stop, such as a bus stop; its genitive is 'pysäkin'.
questions.exampletranslate: I wait for the bus at the stop.

questions.question: Bicycle / Wheel
questions.exampletranslate: I ride a bicycle to work.

questions.question: Radio
questions.exampletranslate: I listen to the radio in the morning.

questions.question: Broken
questions.exampletranslate: The phone is broken.

questions.question: Terraced / Row house
questions.explanation: 'Rivitalo' means a terraced or row house.
questions.exampletranslate: We live in a row house.

questions.question: Trash / Litter
questions.explanation: 'Roska' means trash or litter (a piece of rubbish).
questions.exampletranslate: I take the trash out.

questions.question: Ugly
questions.exampletranslate: This building is ugly.

questions.question: Leftovers (food)
questions.explanation: 'Ruoantähde' means food leftovers; its genitive is 'ruoantähteen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I eat the leftovers for lunch.

questions.question: Wall
questions.exampletranslate: The picture is on the wall.

questions.question: Mixed waste
questions.explanation: 'Sekajäte' means mixed waste; its genitive is 'sekajätteen'.
questions.exampletranslate: Plastic goes in the mixed waste.

questions.question: Tidy / Clean
questions.exampletranslate: The room is now tidy.

questions.question: Glasses (eyeglasses)
questions.explanation: 'Silmälasit' means eyeglasses (a plural word); its genitive is 'silmälasien'.
questions.exampletranslate: I wear glasses when reading.

questions.question: Big / Large
questions.explanation: 'Suuri' means big or large; its genitive is 'suuren'.
questions.exampletranslate: This is a large apartment.

questions.question: Electricity
questions.exampletranslate: Electricity is expensive.

questions.question: Canned food / Preserve
questions.explanation: 'Säilyke' means canned food or a preserve; its genitive is 'säilykkeen'.
questions.exampletranslate: There are canned foods in the cupboard.

questions.question: Sky
questions.exampletranslate: The sky is blue.

questions.question: Picture / Painting / Board
questions.explanation: 'Taulu' means a picture, painting or board.
questions.exampletranslate: I hang the picture on the wall.

questions.question: Greetings / Regards
questions.explanation: 'Terveiset' means greetings or regards (a plural word); its genitive is 'terveisten'.
questions.exampletranslate: Greetings to the family!

questions.question: Road
questions.exampletranslate: The house is by the road.

questions.question: Space
questions.exampletranslate: There is a lot of space in the apartment.

questions.question: Market square
questions.exampletranslate: I buy vegetables from the market square.

questions.question: Empty
questions.exampletranslate: The bottle is empty.

questions.question: To like
questions.explanation: 'Tykätä' (type 4 verb) means to like; 'tykkään' is 'I like' (used with 'mistä').
questions.exampletranslate: I like this apartment.

questions.question: Pillow
questions.exampletranslate: The pillow is on the bed.

questions.question: Coworker
questions.exampletranslate: My coworker is nice.

questions.question: To swim
questions.explanation: 'Uida' (type 1 verb) means to swim; 'uin' is 'I swim'.
questions.exampletranslate: I swim in the lake in summer.

questions.question: Often
questions.exampletranslate: I often go swimming.

questions.question: Clothing / Garment
questions.explanation: 'Vaate' means a garment or item of clothing; its genitive is 'vaatteen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy new clothes.

questions.question: To change / swap
questions.explanation: 'Vaihtaa' (type 1 verb) means to change or swap; 'vaihdan' is 'I change'.
questions.exampletranslate: I am changing apartments.

questions.question: Diaper
questions.exampletranslate: The baby needs a new diaper.

questions.question: To receive
questions.explanation: 'Vastaanottaa' (type 1 verb) means to receive; 'vastaanotan' is 'I receive'.
questions.exampletranslate: I receive the package.

questions.question: Knife
questions.exampletranslate: I cut the bread with a knife.

questions.question: Curtain
questions.exampletranslate: I close the curtains in the evening.

questions.question: Next to / Beside
questions.explanation: 'Vieressä' means next to or beside (used with 'mistä').
questions.exampletranslate: The shop is next to the house.

questions.question: Week
questions.exampletranslate: One week is seven days.

questions.question: Rent (the payment)
questions.exampletranslate: I pay the rent every month.

questions.question: To rent
questions.explanation: 'Vuokrata' (type 4 verb) means to rent; 'vuokraan' is 'I rent'.
questions.exampletranslate: I rent an apartment in the centre.

questions.question: Color
questions.exampletranslate: What is your favorite color?

questions.question: Colorful
questions.exampletranslate: The apartment has colorful curtains.

questions.question: Wrong / Incorrect
questions.exampletranslate: I answered incorrectly.

questions.question: Simple
questions.exampletranslate: This is a simple recipe.

questions.question: Studio apartment (one room)
questions.exampletranslate: The student lives in a studio apartment.
